cards.text: Micah, a prophet from Moresheth (Micah 1:1), has just promised a ruler from Bethlehem who will shepherd God's flock (Micah 5:2-4). Now he looks ahead to the remnant of Jacob, what's left of God's people, out in the midst of many peoples. And friend, he paints TWO pictures of them.

cards.question: In Micah's first picture, what is the remnant of Jacob like among many peoples?
Micah also compares the remnant to showers on the grass. Those showers wait on people before they come.

cards.text: Showers don't call ahead, friend, they don't ask if now's a good time, they just SHOW UP. Now Micah's second picture: same remnant, same crowd of nations.

cards.question: In Micah's second picture, what is the remnant of Jacob like among the nations?

answers.text: A lion among the forest beasts

cards.text: The remnant is like a young lion among flocks of sheep, trampling and tearing as it passes through. I was RELAXING with that dew, friend, and Micah hits me with a LION!

cards.question: In Micah's lion picture, someone comes along to rescue the sheep.

cards.text: Then comes a promise spoken right to them: their hand will be lifted over their foes.

cards.question: Micah's promise goes on: all your ___ will be cut off.

cards.text: Now the LORD speaks: "In that day," declares the LORD, and He starts a list of what He'll remove from among His people. First up, two things from the army.

cards.question: The LORD says He will remove their ___ from among them and wreck their ___.

cards.text: Then He keeps going, and He says He'll remove the cities of their land.

cards.question: After the cities, the LORD says He will also tear down all their strongholds.

cards.text: Horses, chariots, cities, strongholds, that's like somebody taking your car, your spare keys AND the garage. Then the list moves on, and the LORD says He'll cut the sorceries from their hand.

cards.question: Along with cutting off sorceries, the LORD says His people will have no ___.

cards.text: No fortune-tellers, and I don't need one, because I already know my future and it smells like chocolate chips. Next the LORD names the carved images and sacred pillars, and this time He says why.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say He'll cut off the carved images and sacred pillars?

answers.text: So they stop bowing to their own handiwork
So the land has room for more crops
So the nations cannot carry them off

cards.text: Bowing to your own handiwork? I make cookies with this mustache all day, friend, and I'll admit ONE batch almost got me on my knees. Then the LORD says He'll root out the Asherah poles and demolish their cities.
Last, the LORD turns to the nations. He says He'll take vengeance in anger and wrath.

cards.question: Which nations does the LORD say He'll take vengeance on?

answers.text: The ones that have not obeyed Him
The ones that lie closest to Israel
The ones that have never been warned
